newsitem.title: USA: Palomar to spin-off electronics units.
newsitem.headline: Palomar to spin-off electronics units.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Tuesday it is planning to spin off its electronics businesses, preferably as majority-owned, publicly traded companies.

The company said the majority of non-recurring losses in 1996, which totaled $11.5 million, were the result of the assessment of its technology and assets related to the electronic business. The company reported a loss of $37.9 million, or $1.49 a share in 1996.

Separately, the company said its Cosmetic Technology International unit has signed a letter of intent with the Ambulatory Surgery Division of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp to develop cosmetic "Centers of Excellence" offering a full title of lasers, medical devices and services.

Under the terms of the revenue sharing agreement, CTI said it will provide services to Columbia consisting of equipment, non-recourse patient financing, operational support, service, education, and training. Columbia, the company said, will provide facility space, clinical personnel and some administrative services.
